description: Four channel quantizer: each input is snapped to the notes switched on in the current scene, with sixteen scenes and octave transposition per channel

params.text: Transposes that channel by whole octaves, -4 to +4, added to the octave input and clamped to four octaves either way
Switches that note in or out of the current scene, lighting blue while it is on; all four channels quantize to the same set of notes
Selects which of the sixteen scenes is quantized to and edited by the note buttons, numbered 1 to 16

inputs.text: Transposes every output in whole octaves, one octave per 2.5V, added to each channel's octave trimpot and clamped to four octaves either way
Transposes every output in semitones, rounded from 1.2 semitones per volt so 10V gives an octave; it moves the quantized note rather than the scale, despite the panel printing root
The pitch to quantize on that channel, in volts per octave; with nothing patched it takes whatever is at the first channel's input
Selects the scene, 1.6 scenes per volt added to the scenes knob, so 10V covers all sixteen

outputs.text: The quantized pitch for that channel, in volts per octave, after the scene's notes and both transpositions

notes: Every note is switched off in all sixteen scenes when the module is placed, and an empty scene passes plain semitones, so a note button has to be turned on before a scale is heard
menu: Quantization mode — takes a pitch Down to the nearest note switched on, Up to it, or to whichever of the two is Nearest; Down is the default
Load scales — reads all sixteen scenes back in from a JSON file
Save scales — writes all sixteen scenes out to a JSON file; the scenes are saved with the patch as well
